note: The To-do tab (Kimani, 2026-11-10): every to-do grouped under the bigger job it belongs to. A group holds question cards (by id, moved here from the Questions tab, answers still save to "answers") and plain items (ticks and notes save to the sheet's db, collection "todo", one doc per id). An item with "done" was recorded done by a thread. Every TD question must sit in a group.

groups.name: Run the full flow with Noble
groups.sub: the dry run, Thu Nov 12, then the handoff Fri Nov 13
groups.desc: One sitting with Noble and the dry-run agent, from sign-in to a sent report, and everything it needs before and after.

items.name: Pick the dry-run agent and invite them
items.desc: A real agent who hasn't seen the tool. Invite their address from Access in the comp report; TD-16 below checks the invite works end to end.

items.name: Noble reads and approves the glossary and the guide
items.desc: The onboarding guide and glossary (#152) are as built; Noble signs off on the words before training.

items.name: Run one seller report end to end
items.desc: New report, details, comps by link, Sort and review, Findings, Send with the Designed email, Done.

items.name: Run one buyer report as a Practice agent
items.desc: Same flow on the buyer side, signed in as the trainee, so Hubert's feedback and the client's budget show.

items.name: Paste the Designed email into Gmail and Apple Mail
items.desc: Check the photos, the range and the sign-off (name, phone, headshot from the roster) arrive intact.

items.name: Leave a dev note at every hiccup
items.desc: Ctrl+. (⌘.) on the page, so each one lands with its screen and context.

items.name: Bring it back to chat for the debrief
items.desc: Share the recording or transcript (feedback folder) and say what went wrong; a thread turns the notes and the recording into a fix list.

items.name: Approve the fix list, then one merge and release
items.desc: The debrief's fixes merged and released before Friday morning.

items.name: Hand the tool to Noble for agent training
items.desc: Fri Nov 13. Existing agents get it later, after the Tuesday-meeting rundown.

groups.name: Check production and its settings
groups.sub: Netlify, sign-in and the live site
groups.desc: Errands on the live site and in Netlify that no session can do.

items.name: Add the StreetEasy automation's two variables in Netlify
items.desc: SE_AUTOMATION_URL and SE_AUTOMATION_SECRET, for the lead auto-accept page (#160).

items.name: Open Lead auto-accept after the next release and check it connects
items.desc: Netlify hands functions new variables on the next deploy, so the page still says it isn't configured until then. Signed in, it should list the service's state, not ask for SE_AUTOMATION_URL.

groups.name: Feed the engine real data
groups.desc: Real exports and labels the engine and the samples are waiting on.

groups.name: Finish the design pass
groups.desc: The design work that's yours. The page-by-page checklist is the Design pass tab.

items.name: Work through the Design pass tab
items.desc: Every page and what opens from it, with what's designed and what isn't.

groups.name: After Nov 13
groups.desc: Nothing to do before the handoff.

items.name: Move sign-in off Netlify Identity and re-gate the creative tools
items.desc: Netlify Identity is deprecated; scoped as its own work. The creative tools are open signed out until then, and #120 (X-Studio-Token) waits for it.
